senses.gloss: m. (an adaptation of διωστήρ, treated as a compound of דְּיוֹ־ and סְטַר) a pole reaching from end to end (LXX Ex. XXXVIII, 4; Aquila Ex. XXX, 4)
the transverse staff of the upright loom (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tela).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:3">Kel. XX, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 5</cite> <he>דיסטר</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 149:6">Targ. Ps. CXLIX, 6</cite> <he>סייפא דיוסטרא</he> ed. (Ms. <he>דיו סטר</he>).

senses.gloss: מיפסלת ד׳ the engraving on both sides of the tablets (Ex. XXXII, 15).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:6">Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 6</cite> (corresp. to <he>גליפיהא</he> <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 74:6">ib.</cite>; Ms. <he>דְּיוֹ סִטְרָא</he>).
